name: Flakeroll
subtitle: Roll snow, stack the snowman
shortDescription: Roll a snowball to exactly the right size, stack the snowman, and meet a new rule in every one of ten worlds.
longDescription:
Flakeroll is a snowball puzzle about exact sizes. Put a finger anywhere in a toy-village yard and drag: the snowball follows, swelling over every patch of fresh snow and shrinking in bare mud. At the far end a ghost snowman shows the size of each piece. Roll a ball of exactly that size onto the wooden plinth and it stacks, then a new little ball appears on the red rug for the next piece.

### 100 Yards In Ten Worlds
Every world teaches one new rule, so the puzzle keeps changing shape:
- First Frost and Mudflats: snow adds one, mud takes one away.
- Frozen Pond: ice sends the ball sliding until something stops it.
- Deep Powder: powder drifts add two.
- Sunny Slope: sun slush shrinks the ball by two.
- Garden Gates: small gates let only little balls through.
- Plow Lanes: one-way lanes can be entered only the way the arrow points.
- Gusty Hollow: gusts shove you one more cell.
- Snow Tunnels: tunnel mouths come in pairs.
- Grand Parade: every rule at once.

### More To Roll
- Daily Yard: a fresh yard every day, the same for everyone, with a streak.
- Blizzard Run: chain up to twelve yards on six flames; every undo or restart burns one.
- Wardrobe: spend free coins from stars and Daily Yards on hats and scarves for the finished snowman. No random boxes, no coin packs.
- Path hint: golden footprints show one way home when you are stuck.

### Calm By Design
No timers, no lives, unlimited undo and restart. Warm music-box lullaby, soft crunchy sound effects, optional haptics, a calm-motion setting, and big touch targets on iPhone and iPad.
